page.overview:
Who is Messam Elmdore?

Messam Elmdore de Limberry, also known as Mesdoram Elmdor, is the marquis of Limberry and an antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics. He is a war hero from the Fifty Years' War, known as the "Silver Prince" by his allies and the "Silver Demon" by his enemies. Marquis Elmdore is a popular figure among the commonfolk of Limberry even though he is a noble. He is a devout member of the Church of Glabados and serves as one of Duke Goltanna's loyal generals in the War of the Lions.

Elmdore's job is the ark knight, which is basically a samurai with improved stats.

From the ruling aristocracy of the territory of Limberry, Elmdore served as a general during in the latter days of the Fifty Years' War, where he earned recognition and respect for his fearless march against the Ordallian army when it invaded Ivalice, having also fought alongside Count Cidolfus Orlandeau. After the conflict, Elmdore not only dedicated himself to the reconstruction of the kingdom, but also defended the right of returning Ivalician soldiers to receive due compensation, which earned him the title of marquis. During this period, he became a devotee of the Church of Glabados, where Elmdore became an ordained inquisitor of the Holy Office of the Faith against pagans, and became a close ally of Duke Goltanna of Zeltennia during this period.

Sometime during the final years of King Ondoria III's reign, Elmdore received the Gemini auracite from Folmarv Tengille, the leader of the Knights Templar, as a "gift of good faith", unaware that Folmarv was possessed by the Lucavi Hashmal and had entrusted him with the Stone to mark him the vessel of Zalera, the Lucavi demon dormant within, due to his compatibility. He also accepted the squire Argath Thadalfus as one of his servants during this period.
